stock.description: Net-a-Go Technology Company Limited functions primarily as an investment holding enterprise, specializing in environmental management services throughout Hong Kong and Mainland China. Its service portfolio encompasses street and public area sanitation, waste disposal oversight, and building maintenance. Beyond these core operations, the company also engages in real estate leasing and financial securities trading. Founded in 2013, the organization operated as U Banquet Group Holding Limited until its name change in August 2021, and its corporate headquarters are situated in Taikoo Shing, Hong Kong.
